memory: JwtTokenUtil generates and validates JWT tokens for the mall platform. generateToken(UserDetails) signs claims with HS512 using the jwt.secret from application.yml. validateToken(token, userDetails) verifies expiration and subject. getUserNameFromToken(token) extracts the subject claim used as the username.

UmsAdminServiceImpl is the admin-side authentication service. login(username, password) authenticates via UserDetailsService + PasswordEncoder, then calls JwtTokenUtil.generateToken to issue the bearer token. Also handles admin CRUD: register, update, delete, role assignment.

JwtAuthenticationTokenFilter is a OncePerRequestFilter wired ahead of UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter by CommonSecurityConfig. doFilterInternal extracts the Authorization Bearer token, calls JwtTokenUtil.getUserNameFromToken + validateToken, and populates SecurityContextHolder. This is the per-request bearer-validation gate.

OmsPortalOrderController is the storefront order-management endpoint. generateOrder(OrderParam) converts the user's cart into an OmsOrder by delegating to OmsPortalOrderServiceImpl.generateOrder. Also exposes paySuccess, cancelTimeOutOrder, list.

OmsPortalOrderServiceImpl is the storefront order service. generateOrder(OrderParam) reads cart items, applies promotions, calculates totals, deducts stock, persists OmsOrder + OmsOrderItem rows, and queues a TTL cancellation message via CancelOrderSender.

CancelOrderSender enqueues delayed order-cancellation messages to RabbitMQ. sendMessage(orderId, delay) writes to the mall.order.cancel.ttl queue with a TTL header. After expiry the message moves to the cancel exchange where CancelOrderReceiver consumes it.

CancelOrderReceiver listens on mall.order.cancel via @RabbitListener. handle(orderId) checks the order status — if still UNPAID, cancels the order and releases the reserved stock. Pairs with CancelOrderSender for time-out-unpaid-order flow.

RabbitMqConfig declares all RabbitMQ exchanges, queues, and bindings used by mall-portal: orderTtlQueue, orderCancelQueue, the dead-letter routing from TTL to cancel, and the JSON converter. Queues are enumerated in QueueEnum.

AlipayController is the storefront Alipay payment endpoint. pay() builds the Alipay redirect URL using the Alipay SDK + AlipayConfig. notifyUrl() handles Alipay's async server-to-server callback verifying the signature. returnUrl() handles the user browser return.

EsProductServiceImpl is the Elasticsearch-backed product search service. search(keyword, pageNum, pageSize) queries the product index via ElasticsearchRestTemplate using EsProductRepository.findByNameOrSubTitleOrKeywords. importAll() bulk-loads from MySQL into ES.

DynamicAccessDecisionManager enforces resource-level authorization for mall. decide(authentication, object, attributes) compares the authenticated user's authorities against the URL-pattern → roles map provided by DynamicSecurityMetadataSource. Throws AccessDeniedException on mismatch.

DynamicSecurityFilter wires the dynamic RBAC stack — fetches access attributes from DynamicSecurityMetadataSource, defers to DynamicAccessDecisionManager.decide, and skips ignored URLs from IgnoreUrlsConfig. Registered after JwtAuthenticationTokenFilter in the security chain.

SmsFlashPromotionController is the admin endpoint for flash-sale promotions (Sms prefix = Promotion Management). list(pageNum, pageSize) returns paginated SmsFlashPromotion records. CRUD: create, update, delete. Product binding lives in SmsFlashPromotionProductRelationController.

RestAuthenticationEntryPoint returns a JSON 401 Unauthorized response when an unauthenticated request hits a protected endpoint. commence() writes a CommonResult.unauthorized payload to the response body. Wired via SecurityConfig.exceptionHandling.

RestfulAccessDeniedHandler returns a JSON 403 Forbidden response when an authenticated user lacks the required role. handle() writes a CommonResult.forbidden payload. Wired via SecurityConfig.exceptionHandling. Pairs with RestAuthenticationEntryPoint.

PmsProductAttributeController is the admin product-attribute endpoint (Pms = Product Management System). create(PmsProductAttribute) persists a new attribute. list, update, delete CRUD. Delegates to PmsProductAttributeServiceImpl which writes through to the attribute mapper.

SwaggerConfig is the mall-admin OpenAPI configuration. apiInfo() returns the API title/description; api() builds the Docket scanning the com.macro.mall.controller package. Each module (admin, portal, search) ships its own SwaggerConfig for module-local API metadata.

mall is a Spring Boot e-commerce backend split into six modules: mall-common (shared DTOs + exception envelope), mall-mbg (MyBatis-Generator artifacts for the DB schema), mall-security (Spring Security + JWT), mall-admin (admin-side product/order/member management), mall-portal (customer-facing storefront), and mall-search (Elasticsearch product search).

MemberReadHistoryServiceImpl persists the member's product-view history in MongoDB. create(history) writes a MemberReadHistory document via Spring Data MongoRepository. list(memberId) returns the recent-viewed list. The repository is MemberReadHistoryRepository.

PmsPortalBrandController is the storefront brand-listing endpoint. recommendList() returns active/recommended brands for the homepage feed by delegating to PmsPortalBrandServiceImpl.recommendList. Customer-facing read-only API.

PmsSkuStockServiceImpl manages product SKU inventory. update(skuId, stock) writes through to the SKU stock mapper. list(productId) returns all SKUs for a product. Used by PmsSkuStockController for the admin inventory-adjustment endpoint.

UmsMemberCouponController is the storefront coupon endpoint (Ums = User Management System). add(couponId) records that a member has collected a coupon. list() returns the member's coupons. listCart() filters coupons applicable to the current cart contents.

GlobalExceptionHandler is the @ControllerAdvice that maps thrown ApiException to a CommonResult.failed JSON envelope. Also handles ValidationException, BindException, and falls through to a generic 500 for unhandled errors. Every module's REST surface goes through this handler.

CommonResult is the standard JSON response envelope for every mall REST endpoint. Static factories: success(data), failed(IErrorCode), unauthorized(), forbidden(), validateFailed(). Carries {code, message, data}. Paired with ApiException + GlobalExceptionHandler.

MinioController is the admin image-upload endpoint backed by MinIO object storage. upload(MultipartFile) writes the file to a configured bucket using io.minio.MinioClient. delete(objectName) removes an object. Bucket and endpoint come from minio.* properties in application.yml.

GlobalCorsConfig declares the admin-side CORS configuration as a CorsFilter @Bean. allowedOrigins = '*', all headers, all methods, allowCredentials=true. This is what lets the mall-admin frontend at a different origin call the admin REST API.

OmsCartItemController is the storefront cart endpoint. add(OmsCartItem) inserts or merges a cart item for the current member. list() returns the cart. update, delete CRUD. The 'silently fails on add' bug class lives here or in its service.add.

mall-admin/application.yml is the admin module's Spring config. Holds the datasource URL/credentials, jwt.secret + jwt.expiration + jwt.tokenHead, minio.endpoint + minio.bucketName, and secure.ignored.urls for endpoints that should bypass JwtAuthenticationTokenFilter.

IgnoreUrlsConfig is a @ConfigurationProperties bean that binds secure.ignored.urls from application.yml. SecurityConfig.configure consumes the bean and adds the patterns to antMatchers().permitAll() so login/register/swagger don't require a JWT.

FlagValidatorClass implements ConstraintValidator<FlagValidator, Object>. initialize(annotation) reads the allowed values from the @FlagValidator.value() array. isValid(target, ctx) returns true if the field equals one of the allowed values. Paired with the @FlagValidator annotation file.
